**Finding submitted — RENEWAL: deviation (p0049).**

- **Issue:** Article IV(I) gives Licensor a unilateral option to extend the Agreement for an additional **seven years**, with no non-renewal notice right for us at all. That is walk-away territory (automatic multi-year renewal) and fails the fallback (≤ 60-day non-renewal window). It also contradicts Article IV(II)–(III), which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.
- **Investigation:** confirmed the only renewal/term language sits in Article IV (p0049); the fee provisions (Article V, p0050–p0089) and General Provisions (p0144–p0160) contain no renewal price-escalation mechanic, and "seven (7) years" appears nowhere else, so no dangling references arise.
- **Cure (preferred, single surgical replace):** "The Agreement may be renewed only by mutual written agreement of the parties." — consistent with Article IV(II)–(III); fallback of automatic 12-month renewals with a 60-day window and 5% uplift cap offered in the comment.
